prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: preview-only high-fidelity desktop Electron dashboard north-star comp, landscape 16:10
Primary request: Design Agent Arena as a green-phosphor terminal fused with an early vector arcade cabinet: a curved black CRT glass display seated inside an engraved angular dark-forest chassis and bezel. This must feel like a physical operator console and vector combat terminal, not a modern dashboard made of neon cards.
Scene/backdrop: Front-facing desktop application composition dominated by one curved CRT viewport, with restrained hard arcade controls, engraved labels, tiny status lamps, and chassis seams around the glass.
Subject: Two original abstract vector provider crests face each other across a central oscilloscope battle trace. Surround the confrontation with dense but clearly prioritized terminal facts, diagnostics, check status, health, current round, attack verification, event evidence, and inspection actions.
Style/medium: High-fidelity shippable UI concept; authentic early vector arcade graphics; razor-thin luminous vector lines, selective phosphor bloom and afterimage trails, bitmap and monospace typography, engraved angular bezel geometry, hard rectangular controls, scanline texture only where credible on CRT glass.
Composition/framing: Landscape 16:10. A compact engraved top identity rail reads Agent Arena. The central oscilloscope arena occupies most of the curved CRT. Codex crest is on the left and Claude crest on the right with clear health/status readouts. Round and verification status sit above the trace; evidence and conflict detail run in compact terminal bands below; Inspect Codex and Inspect Claude are unmistakable hard-button actions at the lower left and lower right. Dense clear operator hierarchy with strong alignment and legible text.
Lighting/mood: Dark command room intensity conveyed only through the physical CRT and phosphor emission; focused, competitive, precise, technical.
Color palette: Black CRT glass, dark forest green chassis, phosphor green, acid yellow, sparing warning coral.
Materials/textures: Curved smoked CRT glass, matte painted metal or dense molded cabinet shell, engraved grooves and legends, tactile hard keys; authentic localized vector bloom only.
Text (verbatim): "Agent Arena"; "Codex"; "gpt-5.6-sol"; "Claude"; "claude-opus"; "Round 2"; "Verify Attacks"; "HP 100"; "HP 70"; "4/4 checks"; "logout-retry"; "Concurrent rotations can both commit"; "Inspect Codex"; "Inspect Claude".
Constraints: Use the real product name Agent Arena. Include every listed terminal fact with spelling accurate and text legible where possible. Two provider crests must be wholly original abstract geometric vector emblems, not brand logos. No copied game characters, sprites, logos, trademark symbols, or proprietary arcade cabinet art. No rounded cards. No gradient fills. No blur outside authentic CRT phosphor bloom. No glassmorphism. No watermark.
Avoid: modern SaaS card dashboard, generic cyberpunk HUD, rainbow neon, excessive decoration, illegible microtext, faux 3D charts, smooth rounded controls, photographic people, copyrighted game imagery.
